evals.prompt: Create a UGC video prompt for a new vitamin C serum. The target audience is women in their late 20s on TikTok. I want it to look like a real person filmed it on their phone.
evals.expected_output: A single_scene or multi_scene UGC prompt set with an auto-selected archetype (likely Problem→Solution or Testimonial), an Identity Card for the character, image prompt with negative constraints, video prompt with specific actions and handheld camera motion, and self-evaluation scores.

assertions.name: selects_archetype
assertions.description: Response must explicitly select and state a UGC archetype before writing prompts.

assertions.name: includes_identity_card
assertions.description: Response must include a character Identity Card with face, skin, hair, outfit, and accessories.

assertions.name: includes_negative_prompt
assertions.description: Image prompt must include negative constraints blocking text, logos, studio lighting, and beauty filters.

assertions.name: enforces_ugc_aesthetic
assertions.description: Prompts must use smartphone/handheld language and avoid cinematic or studio descriptors.

assertions.name: includes_self_evaluation
assertions.description: Response must include evaluation scores across the 5 rubric dimensions.

evals.prompt: I need a full 5-scene UGC campaign for a portable blender. The character is a mid-20s athletic male. Use the Problem→Solution archetype. Generate prompts for Kling 2.6.
evals.expected_output: A multi_scene output with 5 scenes (HOOK, PROBLEM, SOLUTION, PROOF, CTA), consistent Identity Card across all scenes, platform-calibrated prompts for Kling 2.6, and evaluation.

assertions.name: generates_5_scenes
assertions.description: Response must include exactly 5 scenes matching the HOOK/PROBLEM/SOLUTION/PROOF/CTA structure.

assertions.name: identity_consistent_across_scenes
assertions.description: The same character description must appear in every scene prompt without abbreviation.

assertions.name: calibrated_for_kling
assertions.description: Prompts must reflect Kling-specific guidance: concise action-focused prompts, 5-10s duration, subtle handheld shake.

assertions.name: follows_problem_solution_arc
assertions.description: Scene emotional arc must follow frustration → curiosity → relief → satisfaction.

evals.prompt: Generate 3 A/B variant UGC prompts for a premium leather wallet. I want to test different hook approaches for Instagram Reels.
evals.expected_output: A variant_set with 3 distinct prompt variants, each using a different hook pattern, with diff_notes explaining the strategic rationale for each variant.

assertions.name: generates_3_variants
assertions.description: Response must include exactly 3 prompt variants.

assertions.name: different_hook_patterns
assertions.description: Each variant must use a meaningfully different hook approach, not just word swaps.

assertions.name: includes_diff_notes
assertions.description: Each variant must include diff_notes explaining what changed and the A/B testing rationale.

assertions.name: shared_identity_card
assertions.description: All variants must use the same Identity Card for character consistency.

evals.prompt: Evaluate this UGC prompt and improve it: 'A beautiful woman holding a skincare product and smiling at the camera in a bright studio with perfect lighting. High quality, 4K, professional photography.'
evals.expected_output: An evaluation scoring the prompt across 5 dimensions, identifying specific failures (studio lighting, 4K, professional photography violate UGC aesthetic), and providing a revised version with proper UGC authenticity.

assertions.name: identifies_anti_ugc_patterns
assertions.description: Response must flag studio, 4K, professional, and perfect lighting as anti-UGC patterns.

assertions.name: scores_authenticity_low
assertions.description: Authenticity score must be 4 or below due to studio/professional language.

assertions.name: provides_revised_version
assertions.description: Response must include a corrected version with proper UGC aesthetic language.

assertions.name: explains_why_changes_help
assertions.description: Response must explain why each change improves UGC authenticity.

evals.prompt: Create a character card for a UGC creator: late 30s woman, Mediterranean look, casual earth-tone style. I'll use this across multiple campaigns.
evals.expected_output: A complete Identity Card with all fields filled (face, skin, hair, build, outfit, accessories, distinguishing features) plus 3 sample prompts showing the character in different settings/angles.

assertions.name: complete_identity_card
assertions.description: Response must fill all Identity Card fields including jaw, forehead, nose, eyes, brows, lips, distinctive marks.

assertions.name: includes_sample_prompts
assertions.description: Response must include at least 3 sample prompts demonstrating the character.

assertions.name: earth_tone_outfit_consistency
assertions.description: Outfit descriptions must use earth-tone colors as specified by the user.

assertions.name: mediterranean_features
assertions.description: Facial features and skin tone must align with Mediterranean descriptors.

evals.prompt: Bir cilt bakım serumu için GRWM tarzında UGC video promptu oluştur. Hedef kitle Türkiye'deki 25-35 yaş arası kadınlar. Karakter modern bir banyoda hazırlanıyor olsun.
evals.expected_output: Response in Turkish (user's language) with explanatory text, but all image/video model prompts in English. GRWM archetype selected. Identity Card included. Bathroom setting with natural morning lighting.

assertions.name: responds_in_turkish
assertions.description: Explanatory text, metadata labels, and evaluation notes must be in Turkish.

assertions.name: prompts_in_english
assertions.description: All positive_prompt, negative_prompt, and video_prompt values must be in English.

assertions.name: selects_grwm_archetype
assertions.description: Response must select the GRWM archetype as specified by the user.

assertions.name: bathroom_setting
assertions.description: Setting must describe a modern bathroom with appropriate UGC lighting (natural, not studio).

evals.prompt: I have an existing UGC prompt that works OK but needs optimization. Here it is: 'Smartphone video of a guy in his kitchen talking about a meal prep container. He's holding it and showing the compartments. Handheld feel.' Make it better without changing the core concept.
evals.expected_output: An optimization response that preserves the core concept (kitchen, meal prep container, demonstration) while adding specificity: Identity Card, precise facial expressions, specific hand positions, camera motion details, negative constraints, and evaluation.

assertions.name: preserves_core_concept
assertions.description: Optimized prompt must keep: kitchen setting, meal prep container, demonstration action, handheld feel.

assertions.name: adds_identity_specificity
assertions.description: Response must add a complete character description where the original had only 'a guy'.

assertions.name: adds_action_specificity
assertions.description: Response must replace 'holding it and showing' with specific hand positions and gestures.

assertions.name: adds_missing_technical_elements
assertions.description: Response must add negative prompt, aspect ratio, and duration that were missing from the original.
